summary: Persistent sockets live in ~/.ansible/pc and show in verbose output; delete the socket file to clear a connection before the 30-second idle timeout.
questions: How do I reset a stuck persistent network connection?
Where are persistent connection sockets stored?

answer_card.title: Clear persistent connections
answer_card.answer_md: Sockets are in `~/.ansible/pc/` (shown in verbose output as `socket_path`). Delete the socket file to drop the connection before its idle timeout (default 30 seconds).
